entities.summary: Lorenzo Mercadante or Lorenzo Mercadante de Bretaña was a Breton sculptor active in the second half of the 15th century. Between 1454 and 1467 he worked in the Cathedral of Seville, where he executed the sepulchre of Cardinal Juan de Cervantes (1458) and the decoration of the portals of Christ's Birth and Baptism. He used fired clay, or terracotta, and alabaster to achieved naturalism. His style influenced Sevillian sculpture in the last part of the Late Gothic era, and represented the transition to the Renaissance.
